findings.description: The Lambda function's environment variables contain plaintext AWS access_key and secret_key values hard-coded in the configuration. These are long-term credentials (AWS key ID AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE and secret key) exposed in source control, enabling credential theft and unauthorized access to AWS APIs.
The Lambda function uses runtime nodejs12.x, a deprecated runtime. Deprecated runtimes no longer receive security patches, leaving the function vulnerable to known exploits that are not remediated.
